lead: A fast-growing Lincoln County city about two miles southwest of Sioux Falls, right off I-29.
living:
Tea sits in Lincoln County, about two miles southwest of Sioux Falls. It was laid out in 1894, and the Census counted 5,598 people here in 2020. It has kept growing quickly since then, so a big share of the homes for sale are newer builds.

Because Tea touches the southwest edge of Sioux Falls, many homes are a short drive from the shopping and restaurants around 41st Street and the Empire Mall area, without being inside the city limits.
know: What to know before you buy in Tea

• Newer construction: many subdivisions were built in the last 20 years, so ask about builder warranties, HOA rules and special assessments.
  • Getting around: I-29 runs along the east side of town for trips north into Sioux Falls or south toward Sioux City.
  • Property taxes: Tea is in Lincoln County, so taxes are set by Lincoln County and the Tea Area School District levy.
  • Outdoor space: Tea City Park is right in town.
schools: Tea is served by the Tea Area School District. Always confirm the school district for a specific address.
faq:
What county is Tea in?

Tea is in Lincoln County. Property taxes are set by Lincoln County, the city and the local school district.

What school district serves Tea?

Tea is served by the Tea Area School District. Always confirm the district for a specific address.

How far is Tea from Sioux Falls?

Tea is about two miles southwest of Sioux Falls, right off I-29, so many homes are a short drive from the shopping around 41st Street.

Can I get down payment help to buy in Tea?
